name: ToastGroup
purpose: Stack transient Toasts and provide the imperative toast() API.
intent: Pin a bottom-right stack of Toasts that collapses in a 3D pile and expands into a vertical list on hover, with auto-dismiss, pause-on-hover, and swipe-to-dismiss.

figmaSource.notes: Code-only behavior component - there is no Figma component for the group. It stacks the `toast` component (node 1565:12728) and its stacking/hover-expand behavior follows shadcn/sonner. The behavior was specified by the design owner, not a Figma node.

useCases: show transient notifications app-wide via toast()
update a pending (loading) toast to success/error in place

anatomy.name: region
anatomy.description: fixed bottom-right, aria-labelled list of toasts; grows/shrinks between collapsed and expanded

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: an absolutely-positioned wrapper around a Toast, transformed for the stack/expanded layouts and swipe

maxVisible.description: How many toasts show stacked before the rest collapse behind them.

duration.description: Default auto-dismiss delay (ms) for toasts that don't set their own.

imperativeApi.toast.dismiss: (id?) => void  (dismiss one, or all when id is omitted)
imperativeApi.options: { id?, description?, actions?, duration?, isDismissible?, appearance? }

accessibility.notes: Focusing into the stack expands it and pauses auto-dismiss so keyboard users can reach dismiss buttons and actions.

behaviorRules: Mount exactly one ToastGroup; call toast() from anywhere.
Keep the newest toast at the front; show at most maxVisible toasts at once (collapsed or expanded) and queue the rest, moving them into view as visible toasts dismiss.
Collapsed, stack the visible toasts in a 3D pile (older ones peek up and scale down); expand the visible toasts into a spaced vertical list on hover or focus.
Auto-dismiss each toast after its duration; pause the timers while the stack is hovered or focused.
Support swipe/drag to dismiss past a threshold.
Reduce transitions to instant under prefers-reduced-motion.
Update a toast in place when the same id is reused (loading -> success/error).
compositionRules: Render the Toast component for each item.
Prefer toast() over rendering Toast directly.
contentRules: Toasts should carry redundant, non-critical information.
Do not hide the only path to an action inside a toast.
themeRules: Use theme CSS variables for all color values.
Do not use primitive color tokens directly.
implementationNotes: A module-level observer store backs the imperative toast() API so it works without a React context.
Toast heights are measured (ResizeObserver, guarded for non-DOM environments) to lay out the expanded list.
Use CSS Modules; transforms are driven by inline CSS custom properties.
do: Mount one ToastGroup near the app root.
Reuse an id to update a loading toast when it resolves.
dont: Do not render more than one ToastGroup.
Do not use toasts for critical or blocking messages.
Do not hardcode colors or spacing.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders nothing when there are no toasts.
Renders a toast triggered via the imperative API in an aria-labelled list.
Sets the appearance from the toast variant helpers.
Updates a toast in place when the same id is reused.
Dismisses a toast when its dismiss button is clicked.
Keeps every toast in the DOM while stacked, newest first.
Expands to reveal descriptions when the stack is hovered.
